title: Pure-section formulas for the constructed scalar tensor comparison
statement: Let (C,T) be a small site, f:R→S a map of commutative ring sheaves, B_f the restricted rank-one S-module, and M an R-module sheaf. The specified module isomorphism of [lem-sfb-ringed-scalar-tensor-comparison] sends the ordinary sheaf pure tensor x tensor s over a site object V to the sheafified scalar-extension tensor s tensor x. Also, the right unitor inverse on M sends x to x tensor 1. These identities hold without flatness assumptions.

source.place: Section tensor-product (03EK), the sheafified tensor formulas; lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict (03CZ), scalar adjunction. For derived comparisons: sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-base-change (06YY). For quotient transitions: proetale.tex, lemma-naive-completion (099M).

proof.text: Apply the normalized cancellation formula to m=1, invert the resulting equation, and precede it by the sheaf tensor braiding. The scalar left unitor sends 1 tensor (s tensor x) to s tensor x. For the second formula, apply the right unitor inverse to the established pure-section formula for its forward map and use the inverse identity and one_smul.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06YY; the ordinary balancing and localization calculation used before the limit in Tag 099M.

theorem scalarTensorModuleIso_pure (f : R ⟶ S) (M : Mod R)
    (V : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj V) (s : S.obj.obj V) :
    (scalarTensorModuleIso f M).hom.val.app V
        (moduleTmul (R := R) M (scalarTensorModule f) V x s) =
      tensorSection f M V s x
